scope: Exact tested toolchain for the combined product (AFM-010). Recorded from a real container run, not inferred from manifests.

image.name: v-flow-exais:dev
image.note: Pinned by digest because a tag can move between builds. Pinning the base does not freeze later apt/npm downloads, so those versions are recorded below as observed rather than guaranteed.

supported: The image above, built from .devcontainer/Dockerfile. This is the only configuration the product is tested on.
untestedNotUnsupported: Host execution on Windows, macOS or a non-container Linux. Node 22 and Bun 1.3.13 may work; nothing here verifies it, and the pinned headless shell and ffmpeg builds would differ.
Any Node newer than 22. Not tested; the declared floor is a minimum, not a certification.
Arm64. The recorded digest and headless-shell path are linux/amd64.
notes: A package's engines field describes that package, not the combined product. This file is the binding statement for the whole application.
chrome-headless-shell is pinned because each Chrome stable bump shifts pixel output enough to fail PSNR against the golden baselines. Bumping it and regenerating baselines belong in one commit.
Verify a live environment with: bun run doctor
